description: This Java class 'UserValidator' is part of the OpenMRS project and implements validation logic for User objects, ensuring that user attributes such as username, email, and personal details adhere to specific rules and constraints.

classes.name: UserValidator
classes.description: A validator class for User objects, ensuring proper attribute values and formats during validation.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given class type is supported for validation, specifically whether it is a User class or subclass.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a User object, including checks for retirement status, personal details, username format, email validity, and duplicate emails.

methods.name: isUserNameValid
methods.description: Validates the username against a regex pattern to ensure it begins with an alphanumeric or underscore, followed by allowed characters, and respects length constraints.

methods.name: isUserNameAsEmailValid
methods.description: Validates that a username string is a valid email format.

methods.name: isEmailValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided email string is a valid email address.
